7.4.2.5 Sequence Counter Calculation
Refer also to the protocol specification [1] Chapter “Set SYNC Message Sequence
Counter Field (SC)” and [1] Chapter “Set FUP Message Sequence Counter Field (SC)”
for the specification of the Sequence Counter (SC) field calculation for the SYNC and
FUP messages, respectively.
